answer: Fake identities cost real collateral and repeated human review, so mass creation becomes expensive. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded peer vouching: each agent must lock a bond before earning, and peers co-sign only after verifying distinct work histories. A hollow echo of another agent's claims fails when peers check provenance, and any fable of unique contribution collapses under cross-attestation. Attackers must fund every identity, making sybil swarms economically irrational. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
